If the total exports of all companies together in the year 2013 is ₹300 lakh, then the profit/loss of all companies together in year 2013 is:

(Assume: Profit = Exports - Imports)
solution:
**Given:**

Total imports of goods of 5 companies in 2013:

Company R: ₹30 lakh

Company S: ₹60 lakh

Company T: ₹70 lakh

Company U: ₹15 lakh

Company V: ₹90 lakh

Total exports of all companies together in 2013 = ₹300 lakh

**Formula used:**

Profit/Loss = Exports - Imports

**Calculation:**

Total imports of all companies in 2013:

Total imports = 30 + 60 + 70 + 15 + 90 = ₹265 lakh

Now, calculate the profit/loss for all companies in 2013:

Profit/Loss = Exports - Imports = ₹300 lakh - ₹265 lakh = ₹35 lakh

**∴ The profit of all companies together in 2013 is ₹35 lakh.**
